title: RiscZero Free Tier ZK Proof Generation Reselling

free_tier_limits.api_access: NO FREE TIER FOUND - Bonsai docs redirect to Boundless decentralized marketplace
free_tier_limits.proof_generation: Permissionless provers in Boundless marketplace; no free quota documented
free_tier_limits.local_proving: Open source zkVM allows local proof generation (requires own hardware/GPU)
free_tier_limits.cloud_proving: Boundless marketplace - pricing model not publicly documented via curl

paid_plan_baseline.note: Boundless uses decentralized prover marketplace model. Pricing is dynamic/market-driven, not fixed tier. No free tier or testnet credits found in documentation.

reselling_model.revenue_mechanism: Resell proof generation capacity or arbitrage between requestors and provers in Boundless
reselling_model.capital_requirement: HIGH - Running competitive prover requires GPU infrastructure; reselling without hardware requires capital to pay provers upfront
reselling_model.automation_potential: Medium - SDK exists (bonsai-sdk on crates.io) but marketplace economics unclear

risks: NO FREE TIER: Bonsai Network free tier no longer exists. Service migrated to Boundless decentralized marketplace with no documented free credits.
SERVICE MIGRATION: Bonsai → Boundless transition means original proposal assumptions are stale. Boundless pricing/economics not transparent via curl.
HARDWARE REQUIREMENT: Competitive proof generation requires significant GPU resources. Local proving is free but slow; cloud proving costs money.
MARKETPLACE RISK: Decentralized prover marketplace introduces price volatility and counterparty risk absent in centralized SaaS models.
DOCS INACCESSIBLE: dev.risczero.com returns SPA content that requires JavaScript rendering. Critical pricing/tier info unverifiable via curl.
next_steps: REJECT as zero-capital candidate - no free tier available
If pursuing with capital: investigate Boundless prover economics and GPU requirements
Monitor RISC Zero announcements for potential future free tier or testnet credits
Consider local-only proving use cases where hardware already exists (not zero-capital)
decision_rationale: Original proposal assumed Bonsai Network free tier for ZK proof reselling. Validation shows Bonsai has been sunsetted/replaced by Boundless decentralized marketplace. No free tier, no testnet credits, no transparent pricing found via curl. Local proving is open-source but requires hardware investment. Zero-capital execution path does not exist. Scaffold rejected per TIER0 requirements.
